    // Lua's own escapes: `\z` skips the whitespace after it, including line
    // breaks, and a backslash before a line break keeps the line break.
    local skipped: "ab" = "a\z
          b"
    local kept: "a\nb" = "a\
    b"
    local bell = "\a\b\f\v"

    local tick = `\`\${x}`
